summary: Heavy selling is holding, not easing: the Nifty is stuck about 1.1–1.2% lower near 22,880 and the Sensex is down roughly 860–900 points, with no sector in the green.

detail.leaders: None of note; every sector index is red
detail.laggards: Financials, auto, FMCG, metal, realty; NSE shares; mid- and smallcaps
detail.tone: Little changed from 10:00: the Nifty at 22,882.15 (−1.12%) at 10 am is just off the 22,856 low, and there is no sign of dip-buying yet. VIX is still up about 15%.
watch: A break below 22,800 would target the 22,600 support zone
DII buying stepping in, as on Friday
